Keys match INCIDENT_TYPES in src/lib/incidentTypes.js exactly. GeminiNarrativeProvider::buildSystemInstruction() appends only the entry matching the report's incident type to the base system instruction (see app/ai/GeminiNarrativeProvider.php). The 'sensitivity' text here is the AI-side instruction; it deliberately differs in wording from the officer-facing UI reminder in SENSITIVE_TYPES (incidentTypes.js) and the architecture v2 §5.2 note — one is for the model, the other for the officer.

Rape / Sexual Assault.sensitivity: Handle with heightened care (sensitive type). Use clinical, formal, non-graphic language and avoid detail beyond what is evidentially necessary — summarize at the level of what was reported, where and when, not a descriptive account. Cite the law by number. Never speculate on credibility, motive, or fault.

Domestic Violence.sensitivity: Handle with heightened care (sensitive type, RA 9262). Use clinical, formal, non-graphic language and avoid detail beyond what is evidentially necessary. Cite the law by number. Use 'Respondent', never 'Suspect', to match the civil/protective-order framing. Never speculate on credibility, motive, or fault.
